name: cn.net.sixu-ai/moyan-audit
title: Moyan Audit — Agent Session Security Audit
description: Security audit of AI-agent session records: 25 checks, three-level verdict, per-check evidence.

tools.name: moyan_checkup
tools.description: Full deterministic security audit of an AI-agent session record (25 checks, three-level verdict: verified / unverified / unknown, per-check evidence). Provide the record as {profile, responses}, or as {session: {profile, responses}}, or as {question: "<session record JSON string>"}. Never include passwords, private keys, seed phrases, or production credentials — such input is rejected before execution.

profile.description: Agent profile object of the session record.

responses.description: Responses object of the session record, keyed by check id.

question.description: Session record as a JSON string (same form as the HTTP checkup endpoint).

tools.name: moyan_precheck
tools.description: Single-event security pre-check from a free-text incident description (deterministic feature pre-check; patterns reported by the submitter are marked unverified, unaddressed categories unknown). If the description embeds a structured session record JSON, the full 25-check engine runs instead. Never include passwords, private keys, seed phrases, or production credentials — such input is rejected before execution.
